gameName: Sid Meier's Civilization: The Board Game

modules.name: Fame and Fortune: great person deck

steps.text: Add its 4 civilizations and culture level markers, 4 techs to each tech deck, metropolis markers and military reference cards
Add its home tiles, shuffle in its neutral tiles; add its huts, villages and relic markers
Shuffle its wonders and culture events into their decks; replace Flight and Angkor Wat with the new cards
Great person deck (all agree): great person markers faceup sorted by type, the deck shuffled beside them
Investments (all agree; required if Arabia plays): each player gets their 4 investment cards
Add its 6 civilizations; add its 6 techs to each tech deck and remove Metal Casting and Railroad
Shuffle its wonders and culture events into their decks; add its home tiles, neutral tiles, huts, villages and relics
Replace all unit, combat and government cards with the new ones (and Leonidas and Endowment for the Arts if you have Fame and Fortune)
Add the Shipyards; market overlay over the Harbor space
Each player gets a deck of social policy cards; city-state markers shuffled in a pile
Learning game: box Egypt, Rome and all wonders; the game ends when someone builds their third city
Deal civilization sheets at random (or pick, if all agree); each player picks a colour
Each: 6 armies, 2 scouts, 3 city markers, 4 military tech markers, 36 tech cards, a reference sheet, a setup card and 4 government cards
Market board at one end: shuffle the 4 unit decks onto it; give each player 1 artillery, 1 infantry, 1 mounted facedown as standing forces
Each player's artillery, infantry and mounted markers one-stripe side up below those decks; aircraft marker star side down
Building markers sorted onto their spaces
Wonder deck: modern facedown, medieval on top; 4 ancient wonders faceup below it, each with its marker
steps.note: Egypt first takes a random ancient wonder; a medieval one fills the gap

steps.text: Wonder deck: 4 random modern, 4 medieval on top, 4 ancient on top; Egypt takes the top card, then 4 faceup with their markers
Wonder deck: 4 random modern, 4 medieval on top, 4 ancient on top; Egypt takes the top card, then 4 faceup with their markers
Culture event decks (ancient, medieval, modern) shuffled below the culture track; each leader marker on its start space
{n} of each market resource token by the board; box the rest
Home tiles faceup in front of their owners as the diagram shows (5 players: the Fame and Fortune diagram); deal the neutral tiles facedown to complete the map
steps.ref: General Setup 5 / Fame and Fortune rulebook (FFG) p.6

steps.text: Great people, huts and villages: three facedown mixed piles
Huts and villages: two facedown mixed piles
steps.ref: General Setup 6 / Fame and Fortune rulebook (FFG) p.11

steps.text: Culture, wound and coin tokens in piles; combat bonus cards, Space Flight and disaster markers faceup nearby
Capital on one of the 4 centre squares of your home tile (first game: the starting arrow), unwalled side up
1 army and 1 scout in your capital's outskirts (not on water)
Starting tech from your civilization sheet faceup as the base of your tech pyramid
Government cards stacked with Despotism faceup on top
Trade dial: the trade symbols in your capital's 8 outskirts squares
Economy dial on 0 (or the coins you already have)
1 city marker, 5 armies and 1 scout beside your sheet; the last city waits for Irrigation
